```plato
    // ONE FIXED STEP: apply gravity and damping, solve contact velocities, work out
    // the positional correction, then move. The returned world carries the solved
    // impulses in its constraint rows, which is what the next frame's
    // `WarmStartFrom` reads.
    //
    // Contacts are NOT regenerated here. Detection needs shapes and this record
    // holds none, so the caller refreshes `Constraints` between steps — which is
    // also what lets the same step drive a scene of spheres, a scene of boxes, or a
    // scene whose contacts came from somewhere else entirely.
    Step(world: RigidWorld3D): RigidWorld3D
    {
        var solved = SolveVelocities(ApplyGravityAndDamping(world));
        return IntegratePoses(solved, SolvePositions(solved));
    }
```

```plato

    // A planar body advanced one step by semi-implicit Euler under a wrench and
    // gravity: velocity first, then pose from the new velocity. A body that is not
    // dynamic keeps its state exactly, including its velocity — a kinematic planar
    // body is driven by whoever set that velocity, not by this function.
    Step(body: RigidBody2D, wrench: SpatialForce2D, gravity: UniformGravity2D,
        step: Duration): RigidBody2D
    {
        var seconds = step.Seconds;
        var mobility = MobilityScale(body.Motion);
        var mass = body.MassProperties.Mass.Amount;
        var moment = body.MassProperties.MomentOfInertia.Amount;
        var inverseMass = mass > 0.0 ? mobility / mass : 0.0;
        var inverseMoment = moment > 0.0 ? mobility / moment : 0.0;
        var linear = (body.LinearVelocity
                + (wrench.Force * inverseMass
                    + gravity.Acceleration * (body.GravityScale * mobility)) * seconds)
            * DampingFactor(body.LinearDamping, seconds);
        var angular = (body.AngularVelocity.Amount
                + wrench.Torque.Amount * inverseMoment * seconds)
            * DampingFactor(body.AngularDamping, seconds);
        return RigidBody2D(
            Pose2D(
                body.Pose.Position + linear * seconds,
                Rotation2D(Angle.FromAmount(body.Pose.Rotation.Angle.Amount + angular * seconds))),
            linear,
            AngularVelocity.FromAmount(angular),
            body.MassProperties,
            body.Motion,
            body.LinearDamping,
            body.AngularDamping,
            body.GravityScale);
    }
}
```
